body: Quick pass: merges cleanly with main, author's quick gate green on 59fc26b6 (pins in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/setups_declutter.rs`; ui lib 538), body complete, no snapshot PNG touched. Flagged ready for the independent review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 59fc26b64e4ddd8654079439a54e290892a844c3 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**What looks good**
- Setups page keeps only per-setup row controls (click-to-activate, "(active)", status line, Delete), New setup row, Export setup sheets (`pages.rs` setups_page). The no-setup branch is untouched.
- Nothing lost: `setup_pages.rs` `settings()` draws alignment, relative, plane, points, axes and WCS pickers; `SetupPage::Fixtures` calls `fixtures_section`; `SetupPage::Tools` calls `tool_list_section` and `sheet_footer`. Each is gated by `editable()` (active setup) with an Activate button, which the Open page button now reaches.
- "Open page" uses `browser_pane::focus()`, which returns early when the setup is already active (no empty history step) and otherwise queues the undoable `ActivateSetup`. The page target is set the same way the browser row sets it. No ad-hoc field writes.
- Tests: `setups_declutter.rs` covers absent labels on the Setups page, present labels on each Setup<n> page, the no-setup page, and Open page activation. No existing test was removed (`git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat`: only `pages.rs`, `tests.rs` (+2 mod lines), and the new file). No snapshot PNG touched. No unwrap/expect/panic added to `pages.rs`.
- Trial merge with main: already up to date, no conflicts.

**Local results (PR head merged with current main)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` | 538 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None blocking.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `pages.rs` grows 1924 -> 1929 lines. The file is already over 400 lines, so AGENTS.md treats this as a note, not a blocker. The task brief asked that it shrink or stay; a follow-up split of `setups_page` would fix that.
2. The new hint string in `setups_page` has a run of about ten spaces inside it ("its own          Setup page"). Visible as a double gap on screen; please collapse it.
3. Not exercised: Open page clicked on a row whose setup was deleted in an earlier frame. `focus()` queues `ActivateSetup(name)` for a name that no longer exists; worth confirming the command refuses an unknown name (as the browser row already does).
4. The absence checks use case-sensitive label text; the hint contains "work offset" in lower case, so they still pass, but a future hint edit could trip them.

| worker | Sonnet 5.5 | 94k | ~$0.26 |

Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination isn't counted.
Effort: effort:medium (not escalated)

A `feat` (each row gains an Open page button): merges at the next cut, or sooner on the maintainer's word. Notes left from the review: `pages.rs` grew by 5 lines; the hint string has a run of extra spaces.
Maintainer (question dialog, 2026-11-12): "Merge now" - merged ahead of the cut on his word.
